## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `location` | string | `resourceGroup().location` | Azure region for the avd-buddy Container App and its user-assigned managed identity. |
| `managedEnvironmentId` | string |  | Resource ID of the existing Container Apps Consumption managed environment (cae-<prefix>-<env>-swarm). |
| `agentApiInternalUrl` | string |  | Internal HTTPS URL of agent_api inside the Container Apps environment. |
| `buddyImage` | string | `''` | Digest-pinned public container image on GHCR (for example ghcr.io/avd-ops/avd-buddy@sha256:...). Empty uses python:3.13-slim with the pinned swarmCommit tarball. |
| `repo` | string | `'avd-ops/avd-swarm'` | Repository (owner/name) to pull the avd-buddy source tarball from when buddyImage is empty. |
| `swarmCommit` | string | `'main'` | Pushed commit SHA (or ref) of avd-ops/avd-swarm to unpack when buddyImage is empty. |
| `tenantId` | string | `tenant().tenantId` |  |
| `entraSignInClientId` | string |  | Client ID of the custom single-tenant Entra ID sign-in app registration (assignmentRequired = true). |
| `mcpAppId` | string | `''` | Client ID of the MCP / agent_api Entra app registration (audience api://<mcpAppId> for managed identity tokens). |
| `agentIdentityAppId` | string | `''` | Client ID of the Entra Agent ID identity passed to agent_api /ask. |
| `agentModel` | string | `'claude-sonnet-5-5'` | Default model deployment name passed to agent_api /ask. |
| `tokenSpendCapUsd` | string | `'15.00'` | Daily metered token spend cap in USD shown on the Status screen. |
| `simMode` | string | `'false'` | Whether to start in deterministic simulation mode when agent_api is not yet connected. |
| `suffix` | string | `take(uniqueString(resourceGroup().id), 6)` | Short unique suffix for resource names. |
